title: test(types): settle the objectui#9683 post-PASS residuals in the walker pin surface (objectui#9692)
body:
Fixes #9692

Post-PASS residuals of PR objectui#9683 (card objectui#9491), worked inside the
file fence the dispatch drew. **Every relayed item was re-measured on this
branch head before anything was changed for it**, per triage's binding
instruction, and the readings are below with their controls.

**Angle-bracket-shaped tokens are spelled out in words in this body** (AGENTS.md,
"GitHub 会改写你写进 issue/PR 正文的字节"): a Record keyed by "keyof WalkableDef"
and "AdmitsNull of WalkableDef's rest" are written that way because the
sanitizer deletes the bracket spelling even inside backticks.

`Clause-②: no` — re-derived on this head, not relayed. `WalkableDef` is
`export interface` in `packages/types/src/zod/node-derivation.ts` and reads **0**
in `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts` and **0** in `packages/types/src/index.ts`,
beside lit controls of **29** and **119** `export` occurrences in those same two
files; both paths were confirmed to EXIST before the zeros were read (the path
`packages/types/src/zod/index.ts` does not exist on this head — that is the
broken instrument the claim comment warned about, and it is not what was
measured). `packages/types/package.json`'s `exports` map has no entry reaching
`zod/node-derivation`. All new imports are intra-package relative specifiers.
Nothing is added to a published surface; no accept set widens.

## One row per file in the diff

| file | +/- | item | what changed |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.changeset/9491-walkabledef-rest-null.md` | +3 / -3 | 5 | the overclaiming sentence is bounded to what the pin measures; pin path gains its `packages/` prefix. Frontmatter byte-identical — proved by hashing the first three lines before and after against the base blob (`c2e20922deebe1c90cb6129af31966116704f478` both times); level and package list untouched |
| `.changeset/9692-9683-residuals.md` | +10 / -0 | — | this change's own declaration, EMPTY frontmatter: test surface plus a pending changeset's prose, no package released |
| `…/__tests__/walkable-def-null-mint-9491.test.ts` | +129 / -5 | 1, 2, 3, 4 | three matrix entries; the swept member list derived from the interface; the strict-comparison source pin; the matrix-width source pin; a docblock paragraph naming what the file does NOT re-derive |
| `…/__tests__/imported-defaults-describe-9034.test.ts` | +12 / -18 | 6 | module-local `ZodDef` mirror retired for an import of `WalkableDef`; its cast deleted |
| `…/__tests__/registry-meta-carry-9102.test.ts` | +12 / -18 | 6 | same retirement, same cast deleted |
| `…/__tests__/imported-defaults-rest-less-tuple-9088.test.ts` | +18 / -22 | 6 | same retirement; this file's mirror was already honest, so the note explains what the one differing member (`out`) means |

## Per-item status

| item | provenance | re-measured verdict | disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 — matrix misses three kinds its own rule names | relayed | **REPRODUCES.** Walkers name **17** kinds (16 `case` arms in each walker plus the pre-`switch` `lazy` test); the matrix built **21** distinct kinds; the three named-but-unbuilt were `custom`, `function`, `transform`. Refinement: they carry no walkable member **other than `type`** (own def keys `type,check,fn,abort` · `type,transform` · `type,input,output`), and none holds `null` — so harmless today, as the card said | REPAIRED — three entries, plus the rule itself mechanised |
| 2 — hand-copied member list | relayed | **REPRODUCES, and matched 15/15** on the base: the literal list and the interface's members are the same set, both directions empty | REPAIRED — list derived from a Record keyed by "keyof WalkableDef", so an added member fails to compile |
| 3 — nothing guards the strict equality | relayed | **REPRODUCES.** Relaxing `unchanged` to loose equality left the five neighbouring walker pins at **194 passed / 194**, exit 0; the firing control (restoring the pre-objectui#9088 normalisation) reddened **7 tests across 3 of the same 5 files**, so that green was a real absence and not a blind suite | REPAIRED — source-level pin in the 9491 file |
| 4 — the source-level zod census is prose | relayed | **REPRODUCES.** The pin file reads no source: `readFileSync`, `node:fs`, `schemas.js`, `readdirSync`, `createRequire` and `import.meta.resolve` all **0**, beside a firing control on `registry-meta-carry-9102.test.ts` (3 / 1 / 2 on the same instrument) and an absent-token control at 0 | **STOPPED as an instrument** — see below |
| 5 — changeset overclaims | relayed | **REPRODUCES.** Overclaiming sentence **1**, proposed replacement **0**; the file is present on `main` ⇒ unconsumed, and release PR objectui#5400 is open | REPAIRED FIRST, before anything else |
| 6 — the same inaccuracy in two more mirrors | re-measured by the filing seat | **CONFIRMED on this head** — two declarations of the inaccurate form, one lit control already honest | REPAIRED — all three mirrors retired |
| 7 — Apache-2.0 headers in an MIT package | re-measured by the filing seat | re-measured again here, see Acceptance notes | **OUT OF SCOPE, report-only** — no header touched, no card filed |

### Item 4 — why it was stopped rather than built here

The missing half is a grep over zod's **shipped tree** for a `null` bound to a
walkable member name. That tree is **718 files** — `src`, `v3`, `v4`, `v4-mini`,
`mini`, `locales`, in `.js`, `.cjs` and `.d.ts` — and the mint the PR body cites
appears in at least three logical sites doubled across module formats. A census
over it needs a file-selection policy, a regex that survives a dependency's
formatting, a de-duplication rule across module formats, and controls of its
own. That is a new instrument with its own design, which the dispatch fenced out
of this card.

It is also, after item 1, the part that no longer covers anything the invariant
needs: the runtime sweep now spans every node kind either walker NAMES, and a
`null` minted only into a kind neither walker names is outside what either
walker can read. What landed instead is one paragraph in the pin file's docblock
saying the source half is not re-derived here — commandment #9's own remedy for
a claim nothing re-derives, rather than letting the PR body's "both halves are
now in the pin file" keep reading as live.

## Reverse verification

Every leg: mutate, prove the mutation reached disk (blob hash before and after),
run, restore from `HEAD`, prove `git diff HEAD` is empty for that path. Direction
predicted before each run; each restore verified by hash, not by an exit code.

| leg | mutation | predicted | observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| the strict-comparison pin | relax `unchanged` to loose equality | RED | **RED** — `1 failed / 195 passed`, the failure is exactly the new pin. The same mutation against the pre-change tree was `194 passed / 194` |
| the matrix-width pin | delete the `custom` matrix entry | RED, naming `custom` | **RED** — "a node kind a walker names is not built by MATRIX … expected [ 'custom' ] to deeply equal []" |
| the derived member list | add a member to `WalkableDef`, leave the swept set alone | COMPILE ERROR | **RED** — `error TS2741: Property 'zzzProbeMember' is missing … but required in` a Record keyed by "keyof WalkableDef" |
| the honest declaration | re-narrow `WalkableDef.rest` | COMPILE ERROR | **RED** — `error TS2322: Type 'true' is not assignable to type 'false'` at the "AdmitsNull of WalkableDef's rest" assertion |

⚠️ **A sub-premise of item 6 is REFUTED, and the refutation is worth reading.**
The card says each mirror "casts around its own declaration to read the `null`
that declaration refuses". Measured here: with the inaccurate declaration
restored **and** the cast dropped, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` reports **no error
at that site** — only the expected one at the 9491 file's own assertion. The
casts were therefore **not compiler-forced**; TypeScript permits comparing a
`z.ZodType` to `null` even under `strict`. They still go away as redundant with
the copies, and the declaration was inaccurate regardless — but the mechanism
the card implies is not the mechanism.

## Gate exit codes

Every code captured to disk **before** any pipe.

| gate | exit |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run lint` | **0** (0 errors, 288 pre-existing warnings, none in the six files of this diff) |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` (all three tsc legs) | **0** |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` (through the shared verification lock) | **0** — `Test Files 200 passed (200)`, `Tests 4671 passed (4671)` |
| `pnpm changeset:check` | **0** |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | **0** — "1 changeset(s) added … EMPTY frontmatter … a complete answer to this gate" |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` | **0** — reports the expected **case 2** (correcting a declaration on purpose): "declared at base: @object-ui/types: patch / declares now: @object-ui/types: patch" |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | **0** |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | **0** |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | **0** (7805 tracked text files) |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | **0** — 0 new cross-file citations |
| `pnpm check:test-path-roots` | **0** |
| `pnpm check:self-import` | **0** |
| `pnpm check:esm-specifiers` | **0** |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (six diff paths) | **0** — NOT GOVERNED |

**Declared narrowing.** `pnpm lint` is `turbo run lint` across every package; it
was narrowed to `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run lint`, which is that
package's own `eslint .` over the only package this diff touches. The same
applies to the suite: `pnpm test` is the whole repository, narrowed to
`pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`. Both are sound here because the diff is
six files in one package plus two changesets, no published surface moves, and
the full farm runs on CI regardless. A repo-wide control-byte scan was run
unnarrowed, and a manual scan of the six diff files for control characters found
none.

**Deviations:** none. `pnpm install` was run in the worktree (exit 0).

## Acceptance notes

**Item 7 — the licence-header question, re-measured here, no edit and no card.**
Enumeration and reading both taken from the same ref (`git ls-tree -r` on this
branch head, contents via `git show`), 2026-09-17T14:16Z:

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/` holds **201** files — **200** are `*.test.ts`
  or `*.test.tsx`, and the 201st is `zod-subpath-single-module-8598.dist.spec.tsx`,
  a `*.spec.tsx`.
- Of the **200** test files: **37** carry an Apache-2.0 header, **149** carry the
  MIT one, **0** carry both, **14** carry neither. Counting all 201 files, the
  MIT figure is **150** — which reconciles exactly with the dispatch's reading
  and locates the difference: the one non-`*.test.*` file carries MIT.
- Root `LICENSE` reads `MIT License`; `packages/types/package.json` declares
  `"license": "MIT"`.

⇒ Apache-2.0 is a **minority drift** (37 of 201), not the house convention. Two
of the files in this diff carry the Apache-2.0 header and were left exactly as
found. The disposition is the maintainer's; nothing here rules it.

**Noted, not filed.**

- `interface ZodDef` occurs in **six** files under `packages/types/src`, not
  three. The other three — `arm-named-export-8784.test.ts`,
  `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts`, `zod-mirror-authors-no-defaults-7735.test.ts`
  — declare their members as `unknown`, so they make **no** claim about `rest`'s
  type and are not instances of the defect objectui#9491 names. Unifying all six
  on `WalkableDef` is a design question (those three deliberately read a def as
  opaque), outside this card and outside its fence. Carrier if it ever matters:
  the next change to those files.
- `imported-defaults-rest-less-tuple-9088.test.ts` carries a cross-file line
  address in a comment (a `:NNN` pointer into the import boundary's arms). It is
  pre-existing, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` is differential and reports **0
  new** citations from this branch, and repairing it was not this card's subject.
  Carrier: the next change to that file, per AGENTS.md's "repair opportunistically,
  never as a sweep".

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— 只动 `packages/types` 的测试面与两个 changeset,一行产品代码
都没动,没有任何已发布类型或接受集发生变化。①「零值普查矩阵」补上两个 walker
都点名、矩阵却没建的三种节点(`custom` / `transform` / `function`);②被扫的成员
清单改为从 `WalkableDef` 的键派生,漏一个成员就编译不过;③把 import 边界那个
`===` 比较在源码层钉住;④三份模块内的 def 类型副本退役,改为导入共享声明;
⑤把待发布 changeset 里那句说过头的话收窄到钉子真正测到的范围。

**为什么改** —— 前四条都是「规则写在注释里、没有任何东西复核它」的同一类:矩阵
的注释自己写着「walker 新增的节点种类要同步加进来」,而三种已经漏了;成员清单是
手抄的,漏抄不会变红、只会变哑;那个 `===` 一旦被放松成 `==`,五个相邻钉子文件
**全绿**(已实测),而它恰恰是 objectui#9088 修复所依赖的东西。第⑤条有时间窗:
changeset 正文会**逐字**发进 CHANGELOG,而发布 PR objectui#5400 开着,合并那一刻
这句过头话就变成永久历史,所以它是最先做的。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 风险低:全部是测试面与散文。三个文件属于别的卡的钉子
(objectui#9034 / #9102 / #9088),改动后各自的用例数与断言逐条未变(15 / 28 / 35,
与改动前相同),整包 4671 个测试全绿。代价:多了两个源码文本断言,walker 的写法
若被重构,它们会红并要求把钉子重新指过去 —— 失败信息里已写明「重新指,⛔ 别删」。
回滚:`git revert` 两个 commit 即可,没有数据迁移、没有发布物。changeset 的
frontmatter 逐字节未动(已用哈希对照证明),级别与包清单原样。

**你要做的** —— 看两处判断:①第④条(源码级 zod 普查)我**没有**做成仪器,理由写在
上面「Item 4」一节,如果你认为值得做成独立仪器,请单独立卡;②第⑦条(Apache-2.0
头)只给读数不做处置,37/201 是少数派漂移,改哪一边由你定。其余按常规复核即可。
本 PR 由实施席**停在 draft**、⛔ 未入队、未翻 ready —— 这是交接边界,按派发令要求。⚠️ 随后由 PM 席在 head `43de3c8cb` 上翻 ready 并入队,判据是从 PR 对象重读的 head 上 36/36 check-runs 完整枚举、9 个必查全部 `completed/success`;⛔ 不认 `check_suite.completed` 事件。验收记录见 objectui#9692 评论 5716068089。⛔ 这一段被改成过去式,是因为本仓的 squash commit message **逐字携带 PR 正文**,「未入队」一旦入队就会变成 `main` 历史里的一句假话。
